biggest_catch: $250 requires $1,500+ in qualifying ACH direct deposits within 90 days; the extra $100 requires 20 signature (non-PIN) debit card transactions in the same 90 days. New members only. The '$700 New Member Bonus' headline on some pages also includes an auto-loan bonus (up to $250, requires borrowing $25k+) and credit-card CardPerks points - those lanes are not verified here.
catches: New member accounts only; TRO must not be on a current United savings/checking or one closed in the last 12 months.
$50 minimum opening deposit on the new consumer checking account.
$250 tier: sign up for direct deposit and receive more than $1,500 in qualifying direct deposits within the first 90 days.
Qualifying DDs = regular periodic ACH credits (payroll, salary, pension, Social Security); excludes in-branch deposits, internal transfers, and P2P/Zelle/Venmo/PayPal/Cash App.
$100 tier: 20 cleared signature (swipe-and-sign, non-PIN) debit transactions within 90 days - only payable if the $250 requirements are also met.
Bonus(es) deposited within 30 days of the qualifying thresholds being reached.
Bonuses over $10 reported to IRS on 1099-INT.
Offer as of 06/01/2026, subject to change without notice.
Eligibility: residents of AR, IN, MI, OH, OK, PA, NV, NC per official terms (Battle Creek page promo is MI-only).

steps: Join United FCU as a new member (AR, IN, MI, OH, OK, PA, NV, NC) and open a new consumer checking account with a $50 minimum opening deposit.
Sign up for direct deposit and receive more than $1,500 in qualifying ACH direct deposits (payroll, pension, Social Security; no P2P) within 90 days of account opening - earns the $250 bonus.
Within the same 90 days, complete 20 cleared signature (non-PIN) debit card transactions to earn the additional $100.
Bonuses deposit into the new account within 30 days of each threshold being reached.
timing: Bonus(es) deposited within 30 days of the qualified cumulative thresholds being reached; all activity must occur within the first 90 days of account opening.
